flags.why: The noun meaning dried meat or fish is mainly Southern, but the entry does not identify the region.
The entry omits the everyday meaning of timing an action to catch the right moment.
flags.fix:
verb | to time an action; to choose the right moment
ex: Canh lúc đường vắng rồi hãy sang. = Wait until the road is clear before crossing.

flags.why: The example uses canh cửi meaning weaving rather than canh meaning warp threads, as distinguished in [Rung's dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Canh).
flags.fix: Sợi canh trên khung cửi bị đứt. = A warp thread on the loom broke.

flags.why: Canh is not an independently usable Vietnamese word for classics or scripture, and đọc canh does not mean reading such texts.
